# Exploration versus delivery — M03

Allocate ten weekly effort points between research and shipping across twenty weeks. Native vertical range inputs support drag, touch and keyboard. Pin a baseline, edit or apply patterns, inspect a week’s exact evidence, undo, reset and export. Plan edits replay both outcomes with fixed seeded conditions; assumptions and scenario are shared across plans.

The team starts with two estimates at 0.5. Research observes needs with noise, usefulness weighting and diminishing returns; it cannot teach technical fit. Shipping generates stronger technical and weaker needs observations, delayed 1–5 weeks. Beliefs are updated only from those explicit observations. The observer can see the hidden world; the team cannot. Environmental change can make delayed signals stale.

Useful output is build effort times an exponential fit score. Units, coefficients and scenarios are fictional, without calibration, work-item sizes or rework. More research can improve need estimates while sacrificing output or delaying technical learning. Local storage: `thinking-lab:exploration:v1`. Markdown export includes allocations, baseline and evidence.

Run `node --test dist/exploration/engine.test.js`. Browser input and layout checks belong to integration.
